headline: DFT reference data refines torsion parameters and hybrid ML/MM simulation setup
label: Quantum Informed Force Field Refinement
summary: DFT-level reference data is being used to refit force field torsions and to build hybrid neural network/MM simulation systems.
synthesis: The dominant thread is quantum-mechanical reference data supplying the fidelity of molecular energy models for biomolecular simulation. AFFDO, a GPU-accelerated platform, refits GAFF2 torsion parameters for drug-like ligands against DFT reference data, improving agreement with QM. CHARMM-GUI Hybrid ML/MM Builder automates preparation of protein-ligand systems and input files for hybrid neural network potential/molecular mechanics simulations. What is new is the coupling of GPU-accelerated DFT-level reference data with parameter refitting and hybrid ML/MM system construction. The DBFE preprint, an alchemy-free absolute binding free energy method in implicit solvent with publicly released code, addresses a separate problem and is not representative of this thread.
